gate_requirements: gate must record the Git commit that added the exact shortlist freeze hash before HOLDOUT is queried

refit_policy.training_population: TRAIN plus DEV decisions strictly before dev_end-300s, with target label_end < dev_end
refit_policy.sampling: deterministic hash(condition_id, tx_hash, log_index), balanced by family where possible
refit_policy.hyperparameters: exact DEV-selected model and params; no HOLDOUT tuning

holdout_population.evaluation: all valid rows; no target-value sampling

scalar_shortlist_policy.per_target: first stable_train_dev candidate in frozen order only

baseline_comparators.persistence: zero future change for price-change targets; TRAIN+DEV mean for positive movement targets; majority/prior for sign classification
baseline_comparators.comparator_fit: TRAIN+DEV only with the same final purge/embargo and no HOLDOUT selection

uncertainty.hierarchical_bootstrap: resample election family, then market within family, on market-level metric differences
uncertainty.calendar_block_bootstrap: resample contiguous 3-day blocks of day-level metric differences
